card.name: Linking words before cancer terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as and, of, other and including that sit right before a cancer or malignancy name like melanoma, lymphoma or carcinoma. Seen in warnings about malignancy risk.

modes.label: Of after rate or risk
modes.description: The word of after incidence, rate, risk or history, just before a named skin cancer.
modes.example: the incidence<< of>> basal cell carcinoma was 0.4

modes.label: And or other in a cancer list
modes.description: The word and or other joining cancer types in a list, as in lymphoma and other malignancies.
modes.example: Lymphoma and<< other>> malignancies, some fatal, have been
